title: Why You Laugh More When Others Are Laughing
hook: Why do you laugh harder when others are laughing?

narration.text: You are more likely to find a joke funnier if you hear others laughing.
This is called social contagion, and it is a powerful human behaviour.
Our brains use other people's reactions to interpret situations.
Laughter signals that something is safe and enjoyable.
This can make even a weak joke seem much funnier.
It is why sitcoms still use laugh tracks, even today.
Next time you are watching comedy, notice if a laugh track changes your reaction, then like this if it surprised you and subscribe for more insights.

description: Have you ever noticed how infectious laughter can be? This video explains the science behind why you tend to find jokes funnier when others are laughing around you. It is a fascinating look at social contagion and how our brains interpret social cues.
topic: Why people tend to rate a joke as funnier if they hear others laughing. This is about social influence.
